name: create_org
does: organization, Neo4j database, keys, billing account

name: invite_member
does: invite to org or workspace with role

name: set_member_role
does: set a role or remove (role `none`) at org or workspace

name: list_members
does: members with roles at either scope

name: create_workspace
does: workspace plus its main repo binding and production branch

name: update_workspace
does: governance mode, retention mode, promotion thresholds, budgets, model routes

name: create_api_key
does: purpose-locked keys for humans and services

name: register_agent
does: opens a Context PR adding `.oxagen/agents/<slug>.toml` and the generated harness files; identity is created on merge

name: update_agent
does: a Context PR changing the definition; identity and belt update on merge

name: retire_agent
does: a Context PR removing the file; principal retired, never deleted

name: set_role_grants
does: role's grants and resource scopes; `list_roles` is its read side, folded into `get_agent` and the Tools page

name: enroll_host
does: device key, host agent, bundle, hooks

name: get_policy_bundle
does: signed bundle for a host or agent

name: list_runs
does: by operator, agent, task, tier, verdict

name: get_run
does: run with turns, steps, frames, receipts, cost

name: resolve_approval
does: approve or deny, mints the token

name: send_message
does: message to `@<agent-slug>`, `@agents`, or a run id, with a delivery mode; reaches `applied` at the model request that carried it (§7.3, §7.6)

name: list_messages
does: sent and received, with delivery outcome

name: search_tools
does: belt search meta-tool; also the UI's command menu

name: set_connection
does: credential to a tool server or provider, tested before save

name: grant_mandate
does: bounded authority for a consequence tag to an agent

name: set_approval_rules
does: the customer's approval and auto-approval rules, as a policy version

name: link_repository
does: link, role, production branch, issue import

name: propose_ontology_version
does: profiler plus author; opens the pull request on the main repo (merge activates, §11.8)

name: get_ontology
does: active version, classes, relations, synonyms, proposals, diffs; also served to agents as `graph` frames

name: recall_context
does: the provider's query, as a tool for agents

name: get_spend
does: rollups at any level with basis

name: list_incidents
does: tamper, probes, chain breaks, mandate exceptions

name: set_event_subscription
does: event kinds, filters, delivery mode; returns the unique endpoint (§7.7)

name: list_event_subscriptions
does: with delivery health and dead letters

name: ask_assistant
does: a turn of the in-app agent
